name: session-hygiene
description: Configurable tripwires for the rules you keep forgetting, and a handoff card of open loops left by earlier sessions

holdEnvSourcing.title: Hold env-file sourcing
holdEnvSourcing.description: Ask before a command sources a .env file into the shell

mutationCheckTests.title: Mutation-check new tests
mutationCheckTests.description: Remind Claude to prove a new test file fails without the code it covers

reviewBeforePush.title: Review before push
reviewBeforePush.description: Flag a git push with edits made since the last local /code-review

uncheckedRepos.title: Repos CI doesn't typecheck or build
uncheckedRepos.description: Path fragments (e.g. /my-app/). In these repos, flag pushes after TypeScript edits with no typecheck, and merges after package.json or next.config changes with no local build

middlewareRouteRepos.title: Next.js repos with a middleware route allowlist
middlewareRouteRepos.description: Path fragments. A new top-level src/app/<route>/page.tsx here gets a reminder to add the route to src/middleware.ts

bannedStrings.title: Banned strings
bannedStrings.description: Case-insensitive text that should never be written into a file

supabase.title: Supabase rules
supabase.description: Ask before using a service-role key; after a migration, remind to NOTIFY pgrst and revoke default grants on new tables
